entries.o: <fe><02><0a><32><37><34><62><5f><30><30><34><39><00>The next thing we knew,\nyou were out cold.
<fe><02><0a><32><37><34><62><5f><30><30><36><37><00>That chick with the axe\nkept chasing me around.
<fe><02><0a><32><37><34><62><5f><30><30><39><31><00>I agree. We'll all be safer\nif we stay together.
<fe><02><0a><32><37><34><62><5f><30><30><39><32><00>Well then, the answer's\nyes, if you're willing...
<fe><02><0a><32><37><34><62><5f><30><31><30><30><00>But the pillar's too\ndamaged to read it.
<fe><02><0a><32><37><34><62><5f><30><31><30><33><00>I wonder if there's\na four-leaf clover here...
<fe><02><0a><32><37><34><62><5f><30><31><30><36><00>Lina, don't forget that\nEin still has amnesia.
<fe><02><0a><32><37><34><62><5f><30><31><31><38><00>(I've gotta find one!\nFour leaves... Four leaves...)

<fe><02><0a><32><37><34><62><5f><30><31><32><30><00>(I'm not surprised that\nLina believes in this...)<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><37><34><62><5f><30><31><32><31><00>(But Fia? Why is she\ntaking it so seriously?)

<fe><02><0a><32><37><31><61><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Don't worry, you'll be\nreunited with them soon.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><37><31><61><5f><30><30><30><35><00>You wouldn't want to\nbetray them, would you?
<fe><02><0a><32><37><31><61><5f><30><30><31><30><00>Yes, that's the spirit.\nLet your hatred flow!
<fe><02><0a><32><38><31><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>There must be some sort\nof answer here.
<fe><02><0a><32><38><31><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>Will we be able to\ncontinue like this?
<fe><02><0a><32><38><31><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>As leader, you must be\non the battlefield.
<fe><02><0a><32><38><32><62><5f><30><30><31><38><00>But we have nothing\nto light it with.
<fe><02><0a><32><38><32><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>I don't have anything\nto light it with.
<fe><02><0a><32><38><33><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>Return to the dust\nfrom whence thy came.
<fe><02><0a><32><38><34><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>Let's find out what's\nreally going on here.
<fe><02><0a><32><38><34><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>I will. For the Arcs.\nFor all of Rosalina!
<fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>I never imagined that such\na place existed here...
<fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>I wanted you to see\nthe true Riviera.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><32><32><00>After you have regained\nyour memory,

<fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><33><33><00>Someone has awakened the
Accursed,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><33><34><00>children of the Demon God
sealed away long ago.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><33><35><00>They have the ability to
summon demons.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><33><36><00>I fear the demons have
come to reclaim Riviera.

<fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><33><38><00>Those from Asgard have\nlong feared this.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><33><39><00>Foolishly, they have chosen\ndestruction as the answer.

<fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><36><31><00>I couldn't possibly just\nstand by and watch...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><36><32><00>...as Riviera is sacrificed\nfor the sake of Asgard.
<fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><36><39><00>Well, actually... I meant I\ncan't go on as a Grim Angel.

<fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><37><31><00>I couldn't possibly just\nstand by and watch...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><37><32><00>...as Riviera is sacrificed\nfor the sake of Asgard.
<fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><37><34><00>Geez, you had me worried\nthere, for a minute.
<fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><38><37><00>Southwest of here,\nat the ruins of Nelde.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><38><38><00>One of the Accursed awaits\nyou there.

<fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><30><39><39><00>Asgard!? I thought that was\na myth!<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><31><30><30><00>You know--realm of the gods,\nRagnarok, happily ever after...
<fe><02><0a><32><38><35><62><5f><30><31><30><34><00>It doesn't have anything\nto do with us anyway.
<fe><02><0a><32><39><32><62><5f><30><30><31><36><00>Looks like the perfect place\nfor a ghost...

<fe><02><0a><32><39><33><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>It may not have been used\nto bind a living creature.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><39><33><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>It could have been used to\nchannel great power.
<fe><02><0a><32><39><33><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>I can't remember this! Maybe\nwe should write it down...

<fe><02><0a><32><39><34><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>By defeating the demon\nand opening the coffin,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><39><34><62><5f><30><30><31><34><00>we may have released whatever\nwas being contained.
<fe><02><0a><32><39><34><62><5f><30><30><32><37><00>There's a thin sword inside.\nIt's shiny and silver.
<fe><02><0a><32><39><34><62><5f><30><30><33><30><00>Sword in hand?\nShould one of us take it?
<fe><02><0a><32><39><34><62><5f><30><30><35><39><00>It just looks like chicken\nscratch to me!
<fe><02><0a><32><39><34><62><5f><30><30><36><36><00>There's a large sword inside.\nIt has flames engraved on it.

<fe><02><0a><32><39><34><62><5f><30><30><32><38><00>There's also an inscription...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><39><34><62><5f><30><30><36><38><00>¤With sword in hand, the power\nof fire will be granted...¤
<fe><02><0a><32><39><34><62><5f><30><30><39><34><00>Really? It says that?\nEin, you're a genius!
<fe><02><0a><32><39><34><62><5f><30><31><30><32><00>There's a bow inside.\nIt's cold in there, too.

<fe><02><0a><32><39><34><62><5f><30><30><32><38><00>There's also an inscription...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><39><34><62><5f><30><31><30><34><00>¤With bow in hand, the power\nof lightning will be granted...¤
<fe><02><0a><32><39><34><62><5f><30><31><30><37><00>I'm not very good with a bow,\nbut I'll take it.
<fe><02><0a><32><39><34><62><5f><30><31><31><35><00>I'll take good care of it!\nYou're the best, Ein<a2><51>

A cliff on the 
eastern island of
Riviera. Migrating
birds enjoy the
warm weather there.

A stone bridge
leading to the castle.
The moonlight creates
a mysterious shadow
on the water.

In the castle's
courtyard, stone
pillars and small
shrubs line
a garden path.

A tower located
in a corner of
the Moonlit Garden.
The spiral stairs
lead to the top.

A walkway high above
the ground which
connects two towers.
It was reserved for
emergency use only.

Blue-white flames
light the dark
chambers. Strange
statues of knights
line the halls.

A well-maintained
courtyard, complete
with a fountain.
Beyond here lies
the Sealed Tower.

A tower located
deep within the
castle. A demonic
god is said to be
sealed away here.

A humungous prison
beneath the castle.
Giant chains are
a remnant of the
beasts held here.
Not as cute as you, Lina.
What type of egg was it?
I want to take one home.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><31><63><5f><30><30><30><30><00>It's faded, but I can still\nread some of it...
<fe><02><0a><33><31><32><61><5f><30><30><30><32><00>It's faded, but some of\nthe writing's still visible.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><32><61><5f><30><30><30><37><00>The order of the seasons is\ndifferent than before.

<fe><02><0a><33><31><32><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Grandfather once warned me
about this forest...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><33><31><32><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>He said there are dangerous
plants here.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><33><31><32><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>I suppose demons aren't our
only worry.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><32><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>There seem to be a lot of\nlittle animals living here.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><61><5f><30><30><31><35><00>I guess we'll have to defeat\nthem to get by.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><61><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Lucky for me there was\na root to grab onto.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><61><5f><30><30><32><36><00>It doesn't look like\na swamp at first.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><61><5f><30><30><35><39><00>The chest is deep beneath\nthe surface now.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><61><5f><30><30><36><30><00>But we got the treasure,\nthanks to you.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><61><5f><30><30><36><34><00>Be careful. I wouldn't want\nsomeone else to fall in.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>So this right here could\nbe the ruins?
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><63><5f><30><30><31><32><00>Me, too. The mushroom acted\nas a cushion.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><63><5f><30><30><31><36><00>Is everyone okay? That was\none heck of a fall.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><63><5f><30><30><32><37><00>Akurst? I've never heard of\nthat plant before...
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><63><5f><30><30><34><35><00>I hope it's not as dangerous\nhere as you say...
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><63><5f><30><30><38><35><00>Let's cut a piece off and\ntake it home with us<a2><51>
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><63><5f><30><30><39><30><00>We don't even know what type\nof mushroom it is.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><63><5f><30><30><39><32><00>I wanna cut off a piece and\nuse it as a pillow.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><63><5f><30><31><30><33><00>A puff of smoke came from\nthis mushroom...
<fe><02><0a><33><31><33><63><5f><30><31><30><34><00>Are you alright?\nThis is a Silvershroom.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><33><31><33><63><5f><30><31><30><35><00>The spores inside attract\nMantraps.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><34><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>They won't let us pass\nwithout a fight.
<fe><02><0a><33><31><34><62><5f><30><30><32><37><00>So this is the entrance\nto the ruins, huh?
<fe><02><0a><33><31><34><62><5f><30><30><33><31><00>We should only step on\nthe ones that are marked.
